column1: # Where the third-party source in the Windows payload comes from, and what pins it.
# One row per upstream artifact a build fetches. Everything else in the payload is compiled from
# the OpenUSD tree at the pinned commit, including the four libraries OpenUSD vendors in
# (pxr/base/tf/pxrCLI11, pxrDoubleConversion, pxrLZ4, pxrTslRobinMap), so those need no row of
# their own. Verified by Native~/verify_upstream_sources.py; see its docstring for what a pin
# Tab-separated: component, version, artifact, url, sha256, git_commit, upstream_evidence, recorded
# A sha256 of "-" means the row pins a revision rather than a file.
